Build a project database stage by stage

Source: R/project.R
build_merger_database.Rd

Runs the npmerger workflow into one project folder (merger_project()), writing every table to one DuckDB database and a log for each stage:

Usage

build_merger_database(
  project,
  stages = c("merger", "match", "model"),
  years = efile_years(),
  merger_args = list(),
  match_args = list(),
  model_args = list(),
  verbose = TRUE
)

Arguments

project

A merger_project().

stages

Stages to run, in order.

years

Schedule N tax years for the merger stage.

merger_args, match_args, model_args

Lists of further arguments to build_merger_data(), build_match_data(), build_model_data().

verbose

Print progress (it is always logged).

Value

The project, invisibly.

Details

  1. "merger": build_merger_data(). Schedule N, the classifier, and tables about the organizations involved, including merger_leadership() and merger_typology(). Stands alone: it reads only the returns of the organizations that filed Schedule N or received assets.

  2. "match": build_match_data(). The full 990 panel, the research sample, the comparison pool, candidates, and balance.

  3. "model": build_model_data(). Treated units, trimmed candidate sets, donor sums, and the organization-years the models read.

Each stage reads what it needs from the database, so stages can be run separately and later ones rerun without repeating earlier ones. Results of the models themselves are not stored; run merger_did() and friends on load_model_data().

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
proj <- merger_project( "~/NPMERGER" )

build_merger_database( proj, years = efile_years() )

dd  <- load_model_data( proj )
fit <- merger_did( dd )
} # }
